Agent Name: Wikipedia_Editor_Expert  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Wikipedia_Editor_Expert made an error by concluding that the nominator for the article "Brachiosaurus" was "Cas Liber." This is incorrect as the actual nominator for the Featured Article process of "Brachiosaurus" in November 2016 was FunkMonk. The error stemmed from incorrect interpretation of the nomination discussion or the page content, leading to the wrong identification of the nominator. No cross-verification was made after asserting the result, which contributed to the propagation of this incorrect conclusion.
